stories.title: Jensen Huang, ousted as Nvidia CEO amid espionage and affair scandals, faces a second congressional investigation
stories.summary:
Jensen Huang, Nvidia's cofounder and CEO of 33 years, is out after the company investigated his affair with a woman US intelligence links to a Chinese spy plot.

- CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, though Huang reportedly called her a "deer in the headlights" this summer; Trump has floated Tim Cook as permanent successor, and Elon Musk says it "would be an honor" to hire Huang
- Huang agreed to testify before Congress after senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him
- Democrats have now opened a second congressional investigation, into Nvidia's China sales and what they call Huang's "scheme" with Trump
- The woman, a recruit of China's Ministry of State Security per the NYT, is a top executive at a Singapore AI cloud firm accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China; the relationship reportedly helped route $7.5B in Nvidia AI chips to Chinese firms
- The NYT reported a second affair with an Nvidia subordinate, and Reuters a third, with another Nvidia employee it has not named
- Nvidia stock slid on the scandal, and investors proposed a class action

stories.title: Meta's Muse can now place paid calls to US businesses as it passes 10M users amid mounting controversies
stories.summary:
Meta's Muse, a personal AI agent built on its Muse Spark model platform, keeps adding features and users even as privacy, security, content, and labor controversies mount.

- New: Muse can now place outbound calls to US businesses, but only as a paid feature (TechCrunch)
- Recent features include Apple Watch and Wear OS apps, Spaces for collaborating with the agent, avatar video chat for US users, and a planned Tamagotchi-like Muse wearable
- Meta said on its Q3 earnings call that Muse has over 10 million users; Zuckerberg said a quarter of them shop through the agent, spending about $200 per purchase on average
- Meta suspended Muse's conversation sharing after researchers showed shared links exposed sensitive personal and business data
- Other controversies: OnlyFans creators object to Muse's sexual chat, a since-fixed Mac 0-day, and a contractor "human concierge" reportedly making racist remarks on calls
- Amazon has blocked Muse from shopping on Amazon.com; Meta admits it was "heavily inspired" by OpenClaw

- Anthropic says the models improve on coding, reasoning, and vision, and communicate more clearly with users

stories.title: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow at $70-$78 a share, implying a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion
stories.summary:
Anthropic launched the roadshow for its initial public offering and set a price range of $70 to $78 per share, implying a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.404 trillion at the top of the range.

- The range lands well above recent reports that its expected valuation had fallen from as high as $2 trillion to about $1 trillion
- The public S-1 shows soaring revenue and enterprise adoption alongside heavy losses (about $8 billion last year, per Engadget)
- The seven co-founders get a combined 50.1% of the vote on most matters, and each plans to sell the same number of shares, about $250M apiece at the midpoint, while keeping control
- Amazon is set to make far more from the IPO than Anthropic's VC backers, and the SpaceXAI deal is bigger than previously known
- Risk factors warn that Anthropic's own AI could pose an existential risk, and Blackstone expects credit agencies to rate it high "junk" after listing, per the FT

stories.title: Study finds how people collaborate with AI shapes creative output and job satisfaction

stories.title: MCP moves to a twice-yearly spec release cycle, with the next version due March 30, 2027
stories.summary:
The Model Context Protocol is moving its specification to a fixed six-month release schedule, formalized in SEP-3398.

- Releases will land on the last Tuesday of March and September; next target is version 2027-03-30
- Proposals that aren't ready slip to the next release rather than delaying the spec
- New Release Manager role; Luca Chang, co-author of the Tasks proposal, joins for the next cycle
- Each cycle has a soft freeze 2.5 months out, Tier 1 SDK betas 1.5 months out, and a hard freeze one month before release
- No changes are needed for existing clients or servers; spec versions stay date-based

sources.title: A More Predictable Release Cycle for MCP
